game.title: AETHUS
game.description: AETHUS is a story-driven survival game with a low-poly isometric style and deep, systemic gameplay. Explore a futuristic underground world to mine and prospect for the valuable resources you need to build up your mining outpost, while unraveling a dystopian corporate conspiracy.
game.history: After leaving the AAA games industry, Alex's first project of his own always had to be a sci-fi survival game. Inspired both by classics like Lego Rock Raiders and modern survival gems like Subnautica, AETHUS is a love letter to story-driven singleplayer exploration, built around compelling physics-based mining, and satisfyingly powerful yet accessible base-building features.

features.feature: Deep, story-driven exploration - follow in the boot-prints of a disastrous corporate science expedition and navigate arid desert caverns, misty subterranean jungles and sweltering magma caves in search of vast abandoned underground facilities in a fully voice-acted narrative.
Mine, refine, craft and prospect for hundreds of resources, items and tools in an open, physics-driven, futuristic sci-fi underground world.
Build up your mining Outpost - construct modular habitats and facilities, grow hydroponic crops, automate your resource gathering and decorate with extensive cosmetic options and visual themes.
Straight to full 1.0 release - no years of Early Access, just a fully-formed, polished experience available at a reasonable price.
